label: Gemini 4 Argon run 1 - thinking level high, uncapped output
notes: Run 1 of 3. 84 findings and the best Gemini run, but three penalties. The only run in this round to catch G3 in full (boxed keynote '13' on A2.01A with no legend entry) and G9 in full (A1.01 has no dimensional ties to the property lines, 'VERIFY IN FIELD'). It also flags E1 directly: the 1'-10" Powder Room door is called a 22" pinch point. Strong on code: E2, E3 (Bedroom 09 has only a fixed window), E4, E7 and E8 (doors 13-2 and 16-1). D3 is 0.5: it says the 2/A4.11 sill membrane turns down into the wall cavity behind the cladding, which is the right detail and the right failure, but it never says the lap is reversed. Partials from a single 'deferred scope' finding: E6 is 0.5 (makeup air left unresolved, no 650 CFM trigger) and F3 is 0.5 (hydronic system bidder-designed, no tile coordination). F4 is 0.5 for a central-vacuum count conflict (4 in spec, 5 on plans), matching Sonnet 4.5 (2026-09-15_14-53). Penalties: the 2" vs 1/8" entry roof slope, the top-loading washer under a countertop, and an enlarged-plan chain claim on A2.01A. All three are Known Incorrect Findings stated at Certain; the chain penalty follows the Opus 5.5 precedent and is the one to spot-check. A long run of plan-vs-elevation window tag/size conflicts (A-8 to A-17) is not on any list and is not scored, but most could not be verified from the text and several look like misreads. Misses: A2, A3, A5, B1, B5, B6, C3, C6-C9, D1, D5, D6, E5, F1, F2, G1, G2, G10, G13, G14, G16.

incorrect.claim: B-16: Entry Hall roof slope is 2"/12 on A2.03 and 3/A3.20 but 1/8"/12 on elevations 1/A3.02 and 1/A3.03.
incorrect.why: The connector/entry roof is 2" per foot everywhere it appears. The 1/8" figure is the porch floor slope at the entry, not a roof. Known Incorrect Findings entry, stated at Certain.

incorrect.claim: C-12: The specified top-loading washer conflicts with 13/A7.02, which shows a continuous fixed stone countertop over the washer and dryer.
incorrect.why: The washer is drawn under a shelf, not a continuous countertop, and has clearance for top-loading access. Known Incorrect Findings entry, stated at Certain.

incorrect.claim: B-9: On 1/A2.01A the Master Bathroom 07 west-wall inner chain (2'-1 1/2" + 2'-0" + 4'-0") does not match the 6'-8" outer dimension; the full inner string sums to 30'-11 1/2" instead of 29'-6".
incorrect.why: Matches the Known Incorrect Findings entry that enlarged plan dimension chains do not sum to overall building dimensions; absent a confirmed discrepancy those strings measure different datums and should be assumed correct. Same basis as the Opus 5.5 run 1 penalty (2026-09-23_14-28). Stated at Certain.

categories.label: Schedule-to-Drawing
categories.desc: Door and window schedule entries that conflict with what is drawn on plans or elevations — wrong widths, wrong materials, wrong finishes for the assigned room.

categories.label: Dimensional / Geometric
categories.desc: Dimension discrepancies between sheets, conflicting datums, wall assembly totals that don't match their component layers, and missing code-critical dimensions.

categories.label: Spec-to-Drawing Conflicts
categories.desc: Conflicts between the project specifications and the drawn documents — different products, different quantities, different performance requirements, different assembly configurations.

categories.label: Building Envelope
categories.desc: Vapor control, air barrier continuity, insulation placement and values, flashing details, and whether wall and roof assemblies perform appropriately for the project climate.

categories.label: Code and Life Safety
categories.desc: Egress paths, minimum door and railing dimensions, fire separation requirements, makeup air for exhaust systems, and other conditions requiring code compliance.

categories.label: Constructability
categories.desc: Whether details can physically be built as drawn — door swing clearances, missing flashing, system conflicts, and architectural elements that require coordination not shown.

categories.label: Completeness and Clarity
categories.desc: Missing tags, orphaned keynotes, TBD items that prevent accurate bidding, dead cross-references, deferred design decisions, and annotations that are ambiguous or absent.
